corrections.anchor_visibility: Gap visibility is evaluated from A1+A2 minus unchanged_shared_start; a sub-floor or nonpositive bootstrap denominator makes the closure fraction UNKNOWN.
corrections.cost_gate: A scientifically passing metric route is downgraded to UNKNOWN while the planner-owned cost gate is UNKNOWN; no useful PASS is emitted.
corrections.directional_robustness: expanded_directional versus current_fixed is a dedicated contrast; current_directional versus current_fixed remains descriptive.
corrections.metric_route_separation: Token and exact routes have independent predicates and are alternatives; neither route requires the other metric to pass.
corrections.ratio_lower_bound: The remaining-error 0.20 criterion is point-only; its own lower percentile is reported but not silently required.
corrections.token_useful_predicate: Requires point remaining-error reduction >= 0.20, absolute point floor >= 0.005 unless registered ceiling-limited, positive benefit lower bound, and harm safeguard.

prior_receipt_preserved.role: historical pre-correction receipt; not superseded in place
